name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme by default, auto-switching to light only if the user manually overrides it. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light and keep focus on the data, matching Manus’ competitive edge. The trade-off is that users in bright environments might need to manually switch, but we prioritize the majority’s comfort and consistency. This keeps the interface sleek and functional without extra steps for most users.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users who override once won’t remember to switch back, locking themselves into light mode in dark rooms or vice versa. A better alternative is a manual toggle with a persistent reminder: "Light mode active—switch back to dark?" Settle it with a 2-week A/B test measuring override frequency and user satisfaction.

This keeps the default dark theme for focus and eye strain, but prevents habituation traps where users forget to switch back. The trade-off is a slight increase in user friction for the first override, but it avoids the bigger risk of users being stuck in the wrong mode.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t forgetting to switch back—it’s that users will *stop trusting* the system if it nags them every time they override. A better alternative is a one-time override with a clear "undo" button in the settings, not a reminder that feels like punishment. Settle it with a 1-week A/B test measuring override frequency and user complaints.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to dark theme with a one-time manual override option and a clear "undo" button in settings, to balance focus and eye strain with user trust and minimal friction. 
The result must deliver an intuitive and non-intrusive theme switching experience, and Excava's design lead owns it.
